note: Mid slice of 58 twentieth-century composers. Evidence came from Deezer, Apple and MusicBrainz lookups through the shared fetcher (album track lists with timings) and about a dozen web searches; Presto and the Naxos Music Library were unreachable, and the earsense and Albany pages could not be opened. 31 recorded works that IMSLP's list lacks were added (Toch Nos. 6-7, Gal Nos. 3-4 and a piano quartet, Busch, Pejacevic, Cassado, Langgaard, Jongen, Bowen, Carpenter, Pizzetti, Bliss, Weiner, Zanella), mostly without years. Violin-catalogue entry 4293 (Berg's Chamber Concerto) has 15 players and is out of scope. Weak 'none found' skips: Graener's quartets, Fine (all but Canticles, whose Albany credits differ from IMSLP's scoring), Goossens's quartets and quintet, Stohr's unpublished late works, Melartin, Kuula, Sekles, Samazeuilh, Zanella. Wolf-Ferrari's String Quintet Op. 24 (recorded, Brilliant 2024) was not added because its scoring is unconfirmed. The Weigl Nos. 4 and 6 disc is dated 2026 on Deezer. The Ollone piano trio is matched to a disc listing a 'Trio a cordes' of the same length; the Wilson entry covers the four pieces of Book 2 that IMSLP and the recording hold.
